email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 21-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of DemoBasalin via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-17.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
S. Silva (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter672@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
